pages.title: Vacuum Decay
pages.text: $(thing)Vacuum Decay$()$(br2)If our vacuum is only metastable, a bubble of the true vacuum may nucleate somewhere, someday. Its wall sweeps outwards at nearly the speed of light, and inside it the laws of physics are different. There would be no warning. Unlocks the True Vacuum Seed.

$(thing)Insight$(): 220$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cosmic Eschatology, Vacuum Stability.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Metastable Vacuum Lattice.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A spherical bubble of a lower-energy vacuum of radius R nucleates inside our vacuum. Its wall costs energy in proportion to its area, with tension σ; its interior releases energy in proportion to its volume, the energy-density difference ε. Write the energy of the bubble.
